scientific_integrity: Analytic theorem with an independent finite reproducibility check; no external or independent validation claimed. Initial positivity and extinction are essential.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on extinction outside the explicit below-Allee basin; excludes axis starts and f(0)=1; does not characterize attractors outside the extinction basin, stochastic thresholds or spatial interactions.
title: Gaussian-in-generation herbivore collapse in a strong-Allee Ricker system
